preconditions.description: The integers n and k must be within the specified range.
The parity of n and k must be the same.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: any(len(t) == k for t in unique_substrings(stdout))
postconditions.description: There must be at least one unique substring of length k in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(t) >= k for t in unique_substrings(stdout))
postconditions.description: All unique substrings in the output string must have a length of at least k.
